caseName: Minnesota ex rel. Pearson v. Probate Court of Ramsey County
caseNameFull: Minnesota ex rel. Pearson v. Probate Court of Ramsey County

opinions.text: It is ordered that Michael F. Kinkead, present probate judge of Ramsey County, be substituted as a party appellee in the place of Albín S. Pearson, pursuant to stipulation of counsel.
